scope: Seven new cold processes plus the explicitly identical previously qualified q8192/out512 repeat cover all eight frozen cold cases. Every case verifies all268 base package assets and both overriding provider builds. All actual prompt IDs,1216 generated output IDs, first-token logits within0.125 and1216 native callbacks pass. The8193 case executes a complete cold8192 seed and a one-token suffix with state rollback; its caller TTFT includes the seed. Logical7168..8191 cases still execute40 padded q8192 MoE layers. The finite case matrix is not a universal coefficient proof and does not confer long-context, saved-branch, HTTP, soak or release acceptance. The q8192 TTFT remains above10 seconds; all immutable targets remain unchanged.
